fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Gasifier + Combined Cycle with Thermal ODE
description: First-principles lumped IGCC: entrained-flow coal gasifier (cold-gas efficiency) feeding a combined cycle (gas-turbine Brayton topping + HRSG + steam Rankine bottoming). Net plant LHV efficiency ~38-45%. Lumped transient ODE for the gas-turbine combustor/casing metal temperature via scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Higman, C. & van der Burgt, M. (2008). Gasification, 2nd ed., Elsevier (cold-gas efficiency, syngas LHV); Cengel & Boles (2015) Thermodynamics 8th ed. (Brayton/Rankine, combined-cycle efficiency = 1-(1-eta_B)(1-eta_R)); Cormos (2012) Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 37(4):3083; IEA GHG (2003) IGCC with CO2 capture; Booras & Holt (2004) EPRI Gasification Technologies Conf.

unit.name: Generic 400 MW Coal IGCC (GE/Texaco-type entrained-flow gasifier, F-class GT combined cycle)

LHV_coal.source: Higman & van der Burgt (2008), Table for bituminous coal LHV ~25 MJ/kg

cp_coal.note: Coal specific heat (cited, used for sensible enthalpy of feed)

syngas_lhv.source: Higman & van der Burgt (2008), oxygen-blown coal syngas 10-12 MJ/Nm3 (CO+H2)
syngas_lhv.note: Clean syngas LHV after cleanup (H2+CO dominant)

cp_syngas.note: Syngas (CO+H2 mix) mean specific heat, cited

syngas_mw_kg_per_kmol.note: Mean molar mass of CO/H2 syngas (~20 kg/kmol)

cold_gas_efficiency.source: Higman & van der Burgt (2008): entrained-flow CGE 78-83%
cold_gas_efficiency.note: Fraction of coal LHV chemically retained in cold syngas; must be < 1

eta_brayton_design.source: Cengel & Boles (2015): modern F-class GT thermal eff 0.38-0.42
eta_brayton_design.note: Gas-turbine (topping Brayton) thermal efficiency at design firing temperature

eta_rankine_design.note: Steam (bottoming Rankine) thermal efficiency on GT exhaust heat

hrsg_effectiveness.note: Fraction of GT exhaust heat captured by HRSG into the Rankine bottoming cycle

T_firing_design_K.source: Cengel & Boles (2015): F-class turbine inlet ~1700 K

T_compressor_exit_K.note: Compressor discharge / combustor inlet air temperature

m_metal.note: Lumped thermal mass of GT combustor + first-stage casing metal

hA_combustor.note: Effective gas->metal conductance (h*A) in the combustor

aux_fraction.note: Auxiliary load (Air Separation Unit + pumps) as fraction of gross power
